responsibility: Declares the abstract model for execution or reasoning paths attached to diagnostics. It defines diagnostics::paths::event, thread, and path, including event locations, stack depth, localized descriptions, logical locations, SARIF meaning tags, optional state-graph hooks, thread identities, and path-level queries such as same_function_p and interprocedural_p, providing the core analyzer-style path metadata interface consumed by text, HTML, and SARIF outputs.
same_name_distinction: This header is the abstract model half of the paths pair: it defines the event, thread, and path interfaces and their metadata contracts, while paths.cc supplies reusable base implementations such as meaning-string helpers and path reasoning.
